brief: Plan the owner's direction in D-088 and the owner's QR statement.
tradeoff:
- **Operators**: D-033's ready-made jellyfin-web. They keep copying it in until Octave Web ships.
- **Jellyfin Desktop and webOS viewers**: possibly a web client that works with no operator step. Unverified; criterion 6 settles it.
- **Every deployment**: possibly worker cores for repackaging. Unmeasured; criterion 2 settles it.
- **Other apps' QR links.** Moonfin's QR, and any Jellyfin app's drawn the same way, points at a jellyfin-web page. On an image with no jellyfin-web it leads nowhere. That is true today on a default install, and stays true after Octave Web ships unless JS-150 criterion 10 holds. The digits keep working throughout; no one is locked out.
- **Unverified:** whether jellyfin-web 12.4 fills the code from that address (being checked), and whether other TV apps draw the same address.
entry: Following D-088, JS-150 is re-scoped to ship a pinned Octave Web at `/` and waits for its first licensed build. JS-056 no longer depends on it. JS-178, JS-039, JS-056 and JS-150 take priorities 34 to 37. BL-282 merges into JS-150. D-087's gates 3 and 4 become JS-150 criteria. D-033's jellyfin-web image is withdrawn; its JS-151 part stands. D-027 is lifted for weighing Octave viewers' experience; jellyscale still builds nothing in Octave. jellyfin-web stays the e2e gate. The PRODUCT.md wording and five questions go to the owner. BL-229 is promoted under D-083's trigger: Moonfin 3.1.1 shows a Quick Connect QR, and the owner states Octave will draw one. It is its own task at 36, after JS-039, and JS-056 and JS-150 take 37 and 38. D-083's link term is corrected: the QR carries the address Jellyfin apps already draw, `/web/#/quickconnect?code=`, not a `/jellyscale/v1/` link. JS-150 gains the criterion that this address still ends at an approval once Octave Web ships. Given up until then: a working QR on installs that serve no jellyfin-web; the digits remain. The image ships no web client today, so not shipping jellyfin-web takes nothing a viewer has; it withdraws D-033's unbuilt promise. Building JS-150 as written would pin and licence a build the owner has replaced. Octave Web has no published build, so nothing is built until one exists, and the operator's install (JS-056) must not wait on another project.
serves: "jellyscale ships with Octave"; "Installing is boring"; goal 3, "Current Jellyfin clients that authorize every request work unmodified"; owner 2026-11-22, nothing outruns the product.
